schema_version.description: CLI JSON schema version. Bump on breaking changes.

waste.description: Instantaneous heat and pollution load versus sink, plus unrest and the warning flag.

defences.description: Home planet defence counts and dome/station levels.

spy_reports.description: Stored spy reports with age_secs. Each outpost also carries its latest report.

snapshot.description: Recorded empire glance for `hoshi log --at`. Null when the time is outside the retained window.

exported.description: Path written by `hoshi log --export` as JSON lines.

raid.description: Visible raid countdown, matching the TUI overview.

prestige.description: Meta currency, current run and owned bonuses.

achievements.description: Unlocked achievements with unix timestamps. Hidden locked rows are omitted.

daily.description: In-game daily goals for the current day: streak, time until reset, and slot progress.

victory.description: Galaxy victory progress: pirate homeworld, the three paths, and the recorded win if any.

ladder.description: Industrial goal ladder: current completed tier, next goal progress from sustained rates, and completed ids.

season.description: Seasonal galaxy overlay when this save is a seasonal run: rule-set id, window, seed and whether prestige is shared.

species.description: Playable species overlay when this save chose an empire: id, name, brew timer and optional flagship.

rivals.description: NPC rival empires for this galaxy: enabled flag and an intel list gated by espionage (id, personality, home, last action, optional stockpile/fleet/buildings).

tutorial.description: Onboarding hint progress: whether the tutorial is enabled, skipped, and which hint is pending.

moons.description: Orbital moons of owned planets, with phalanx and jump-gate levels.

tactics.description: Home fleet formation, stance, auto-retreat threshold and admiral.

laws.description: Proposed, enacted and repealed laws with approvals and latest expected vs measured samples.

leaders.description: Leaders with traits, assignment, retirement and delegations.

vehicles.description: Named vehicles for orbital mission planning.

planned.description: In-flight PlanMission rows with transfer, customer, delta-v and arrival.

windows.description: Synodic launch windows from `mission windows` (`open`, `upcoming`, or `missed`).

alerts.description: Schedule alerts: double-booked vehicles or missed launch windows.

delta_v.description: Transfer delta-v in metres per second, including gravity wells.

coast_secs.description: Compressed coast time for the planned transfer.

scoring_version.description: Arena scoring formula version. See docs/arena.md.

bots.description: Arena bot results for one run.
